overview.headline: Allele variation heterozygosity gene pool and diversity across populations

keyPoints.point: Allele frequency at a locus helps estimate the frequency of a given genetic profile in a population
keyPoints.quote: Allele frequency, or the frequency at which alleles are found at any locus of interest, is used to estimate the frequency of a given genetic profile.

keyPoints.point: Measure of heterozygosity across loci serves as general indicator of genetic variability
keyPoints.quote: The measure of the amount of heterozygosity across loci can be used as a general indicator of the amount of genetic variability.

keyPoints.point: Number of possible genotypes can be calculated using formula k(k+1)/2 where k is number of alleles at locus
keyPoints.quote: The number of possible genotypes from only a few loci is great, and can be calculated using the formula k(k+1)/2, where k is the number of alleles

keyPoints.point: Genetic diversity is greater within populations than between populations across continents
keyPoints.quote: Genetic diversity is greater within populations than between them.

keyTerms.gloss: measure indicating amount of genetic variability across loci
keyTerms.quote: The measure of the amount of heterozygosity across loci can be used as a general indicator of the amount of genetic variability.

keyTerms.gloss: individual carrying same alleles at a locus on both copies
keyTerms.quote: if the two alleles are the same, the individual is homozygous.

keyTerms.gloss: frequency describing how often alleles appear at a locus in the gene pool
keyTerms.quote: Allele frequency, or the frequency at which alleles are found at any locus of interest, is used to estimate the frequency of a given genetic profile.

keyTerms.gloss: unique set of alleles found across every member of a population
keyTerms.quote: A gene pool is the unique set of alleles that could be found by analyzing the DNA from every member of a species or population.

keyTerms.gloss: chance of transmitting genes linked to decreased diversity in small pools
keyTerms.quote: a small gene pool is associated with poor genetic diversity and can lead to decreased fitness and an increased chance of extinction.
